name: Customized Cone Tracing
definition: A cone tracing algorithm modified for aesthetic results, specifically altering occlusion, specular, and diffuse cone behaviors compared to the standard model.
summary: Customized Cone Tracing modifies Voxel Cone Tracing with heuristic changes to occlusion, specular, and diffuse sampling to improve aesthetic quality by reducing artifacts like dark corners and unrealistic highlights.
